response.justification: Strong, senior generalist engineer with 15+ years of production experience, staff-level titles, proven mentoring/teaching ability, and recent hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow tooling — a direct match for one of the listed key technologies. However, the resume shows roughly one year of GenAI-adjacent work rather than the required 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and there is no evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks. Python is absent from the skills list and cloud experience is limited to AWS CDK infrastructure rather than AI system design. Worth a screening call if the team values MCP/agent-infrastructure depth and strong engineering fundamentals over prior AI-delivery track record; otherwise a pass.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software; staff-level scope and breadth
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic tooling experience
Strong mentoring, workshops, and consulting/customer-facing background
concerns: Only ~1 year of GenAI work vs. 8+ years required
No evidence of RAG, vector DBs, or LLM evaluation/observability
Python not listed; cloud AI system design experience unclear

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG, vector DB, and multi-agent expertise
Senior engineering breadth, MCP/agent tooling, and mentoring
